# IEEE & AESS Conference Deadlines 2026–2027

**A community-maintained list of upcoming IEEE and IEEE AESS conferences with their paper submission deadlines** — venue, country, conference dates and format (in person or hybrid). It covers **Bangladesh, India and the USA** in depth, plus major IEEE conferences worldwide.

🌐 **Website:** [aionndc22.github.io/ieee-conference-deadlines](https://aionndc22.github.io/ieee-conference-deadlines/) &nbsp;·&nbsp; 📥 Data: [JSON](docs/conferences.json) · [CSV](docs/conferences.csv) · [YAML](data/conferences.yml) &nbsp;·&nbsp; ✍️ [Add or fix a conference](CONTRIBUTING.md)

**Browse:** [Bangladesh](https://aionndc22.github.io/ieee-conference-deadlines/bangladesh/) · [India](https://aionndc22.github.io/ieee-conference-deadlines/india/) · [USA](https://aionndc22.github.io/ieee-conference-deadlines/usa/) · [AESS (aerospace, radar, navigation)](https://aionndc22.github.io/ieee-conference-deadlines/aess/) · [All](https://aionndc22.github.io/ieee-conference-deadlines/)

> **27** open calls · **8** deadlines not announced · **17** closed but still upcoming — across 15 countries.
> Last updated **16 Oct 2026**. Statuses are recalculated every day. Always confirm dates on the official site before submitting.

**Legend:** **AESS** = IEEE Aerospace and Electronic Systems Society event · † = run by a college or private organizer; papers go to IEEE Xplore only if IEEE approves · 🔴 closes within 7 days · 🟠 within 30 days · 🟢 open · ⏳ not announced · 🔒 closed

- **[IEEE NAECON 2027 — National Aerospace & Electronics Conference](https://attend.ieee.org/naecon-2026)** — Usually July–August, Ohio, USA; abstracts due around April–May.

- **[ICUAS 2027 — International Conference on Unmanned Aircraft Systems](https://ieee-ras.org/conferences-workshops/technically-co-sponsored/icuas)** — Usually June; venue TBA. Beware similarly named WASET events.
- **[IEEE ISIT 2027 — International Symposium on Information Theory](https://www.itsoc.org/)** — Usually late June / July; paper deadline usually late January.
- **[IEEE CDC 2027 — Conference on Decision and Control](https://ieeecss.org/conferences)** — December 2027; paper deadline usually March.
- **[IEEE TENCON 2027 — IEEE Region 10 Conference](https://www.ieeer10.org/r10-flagship-events/)** — Usually October–November; venue TBA.

## 🤝 Contributing

Anyone can help keep this list accurate — no coding needed.

- **Spotted a new call for papers or a changed deadline?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/aionndc22/ieee-conference-deadlines/issues/new/choose) with the link, or edit [`data/conferences.yml`](https://github.com/aionndc22/ieee-conference-deadlines/edit/main/data/conferences.yml) directly in your browser and send a pull request.
- Every entry needs at least one **official source link**.
- README, website, JSON and CSV are regenerated automatically after a merge.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for the field reference.

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

Dates are collected from official conference sites, IEEE society calendars and, where noted, third-party listings. Deadlines are often extended or changed, so **always check the official website before submitting**. Listing a conference here is not an endorsement.
